page.layout: One column of running text on the full page, with two headings in its body. No marginal notes. Running head at top; page number at top right; catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: mefes fui Pōtificatus, eo anno quo Gregorius prædictus, in Lateranensi basilica terræ commendatus est. Hic licet multa facere propofuisset, inquit Carsulanus, morte præuentus tamen, nil nobile fecit. Presbyteris secularibus (ut narrat Platina) non parum displicuit hic Pontifex, quod Viterbii post lites inter illos & Dominicanos, super Clementis quarti sepultura, corpus eius sepeliendum Dominicanis tandem adiudicauerit.
main_text.head: 127. HADRIANVS quintus.
main_text.p: HAdrianus quintus, patria Genuensis, è Fliscâ familia ortus, Othobonus antea uocatus, Romæ post Innocentium, in atrio Lateranensi Pontifex creabatur. Fuit hic Innocentii quarti olim nepos (nescio num filius) diuiq; Hadriani diaconus Cardinalis ab eodem ordinatus, & in Angliam legatus, pro colligendis pecuniis cum summa potestate missus. Sed dum controuersias inter regem & barones sedare laboraret, quo quietius res suas ageret, à ciuibus Londinensibus in carcerem est coniectus, demumque liberatus. Anno Domini 1266 magna episcoporum & sacerdotum frequentia, Nor-thamptonæ unū, & Londini alterum concilium celebrauit: ubi posteaquam res, quæ ad Papismu[?] pertinebant, ad statum sibi placentè perduxisset: leges tulit, quibus Anglia longis in posterū temporibus

page.notes: Running head read as "ACTIS LIBER VI", with the page number 319 at the top right. The Roman numeral "VI" in the running head is partly worn. "Papismu" may carry a macron over the final u, which the scan does not show clearly. The line "ad pa" at lower right is treated as a catchword. The heading "127. HADRIANVS quintus." is given level 2 as a title above a passage, but could be a level 1 entry. Some words are ink-faded (e.g. "Fliscâ", "Othobonus", "perti-nebant" at a line break) and are transcribed from the visible letters.
